meta.title: How does digital signage work? In 3 steps
meta.description: How does digital signage work in practice: pair a player with a pairing code, compose the content in a browser, and publish it to every screen remotely.

hero.title: From a blank screen to a working display, in minutes.
hero.subtitle: How does digital signage work in practice? You pair a digital signage player using a pairing code, build the content in a browser, and publish content to every screen remotely. No cables, no technician, no code.

steps.title: Three steps to your first digital signage screen.

items.title: Connect a screen
items.body: <download>Install the SignageWall player</download> on an Android TV box, mini-PC or desktop you already have. Open the screen, scan the QR code from your dashboard and it is paired. No cables, no technician. If you have not bought the box yet, <hardware>which digital signage player to buy</hardware> covers that first.

items.title: Compose the content
items.body: Pick from {count} ready-made apps (menus, weather, exchange rates, social feeds) or upload your own images and video. Arrange them into a playlist and split the screen into zones if you like.

items.title: Publish remotely
items.body: Send it to one screen or a whole network. Schedule changes ahead and edit anything in real time, from your phone or laptop, wherever you are.

capabilities.title: Control over the whole network, from one panel.

items.title: Fleet management
items.body: Group screens by location and publish to all at once or one at a time.

items.title: Scheduling
items.body: Different content by hour, day or occasion, prepared in advance.

items.title: On-screen zones
items.body: Split the screen: menu on the left, weather on top, a news ticker below.

items.title: Works offline
items.body: Content is cached and keeps playing without internet; it syncs the moment the connection returns.

items.a: No. SignageWall runs on an ordinary Android TV, mini-PC or desktop computer you already have.

items.q: What happens if the internet drops?
items.a: The player keeps showing the last content from cache. As soon as the connection returns, it syncs automatically.

items.q: How many screens can I connect?
items.a: From one to a thousand. You manage them all from the same place, with no added complexity.
No. If you can make a social media post, you can manage your screens.
